card.name: Exodus chapter numbers and Ex- starts
card.fires_on: The first digit of a chapter number right after a citation of Exodus (Exod., Ex, Exodus). Also partway through words that begin with Ex, such as ex-voto and EXCALIBER.

modes.label: Exodus chapter number
modes.description: A digit following an Exodus citation, before the colon and verse.

modes.label: Inside words starting Ex
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a word that begins with Ex, such as ex-voto or the EXCALIBER study name.

card.plain: It fires on the chapter number in a Bible citation of Exodus, and inside a few words that start with Ex.
